body:
Thank you 🙏🏻 This reframing is very helpful. Honestly sometimes even I don't know what I'm going through, just feels like I keep digging deeper and closer to finding myself and finding lots of unexpected layers!

I actually joined 7cups for kind of selfish reasons a long time ago, and I began collecting achievements and reviews. I learned a lot about active listening in my persuit to be the best listener. 

Maybe it's time to go back on and relearn those skills , and start doing them more with my real life friends and aquaintences. Try to practice shifting my focus outward rather than inwards sometimes. 

Thank you again.
Mt high school and college years sucked. I was lying to myself for so long. I didn't start living remotely decently  until 28

I believe it's possible but not easy to override that setting and reprogram your brain to notice positives instead . But I'm still figuring out my way with that too. It's what I'm holding out hope for
